results.title: LIV Golf scraps Team Championship tournament in Michigan
results.description: CEO Scott O'Neil said LIV Golf is being reimagined as a "fundamentally new League owned by the players and anchored in a sustainable business model"

results.title: The Heisman Trophy is changing its process to give college football fans voting access in 2026.
results.description: College football fans can rank Heisman candidates daily, with their top three forming one official ballot before the traditional electorate begins voting.
